title: What Accountability Looks Like in a Field Marketing Program
content:
###  **Accountability Is Not a Promise** 

It is easy for any marketing program to promise results. It is harder to build a system that stays accountable to the work itself, week after week, regardless of outside factors like weather or homeowner timing. 

###  **What Accountability Means at SIT™** 

Every contracted hour is documented. Activity is reviewed regularly. Representatives are measured the same way a company would measure its own best employee — not just on effort, but on the quality of the work. 

###  **Why We Do Not Promise Specific Numbers** 

Lead volume depends on factors outside anyone's full control — timing, weather, homeowner readiness. What can be controlled, and what we hold ourselves to, is the consistency and professionalism of the work itself. 

###  **The Best Way to See It** 

A pilot is the clearest way for a company to see this accountability in practice — real weeks, real activity, reviewed together before any longer commitment is made.
